reviews.title: Paid features broken, no support
reviews.text:
I’ve been a paid Pro member of Life Cycle for around seven years and am extremely disappointed with how a bug report has been handled.
In January 2026, I reported an issue affecting the Pro graphs feature, where historical trend graphs were no longer displaying correctly after the start of 2026. Rather than investigating or fixing what appears to be a genuine bug, I received a response stating that the team was “pretty happy” with the current state of the app and was taking its time before considering future changes.
Six months later, the issue still hasn’t been addressed.
For a subscription app, particularly one charging long-term paying users, this level of customer service is disappointing. The response gave the impression that user-reported issues are not a priority, even when they affect existing functionality rather than new feature requests.
It also raises concerns about the long-term viability of the app. If known bugs impacting paid features remain unresolved for months without meaningful communication or action, it’s difficult to have confidence in the future support and maintenance of the platform.

reviews.title: No Support Available
reviews.text:
As mentioned in multiple reviews, the developer website for support requests is non-functional. The app hasn't been updated in 9 months.

I tried to report the problem to Apple but they will only accept reports from PAID users. 

I came here to purchase a subscription but am not going to do that if there's no app support.

Is there anyone on here who has a paid subscription and is willing to report the problem to Apple? There is a link on this page to report a problem to them.
